title: Restart dev servers cleanly and verify the Storybook state after reverting autodocs and the inline-description Canvas hack
objective: After reverting ARCH-STUDIO-STORYBOOK-INLINE-DESCRIPTIONS (owner rejected the Canvas description block) and ARCH-STUDIO-STORYBOOK-AUTODOCS's docs.autodocs config, restart both dev servers with cleared caches and verify: no docs entries in the sidebar anymore, no docsParameter.renderer errors in the log, Controls/Actions still work, full app chain still 200.
validations: DONE: killed both processes, cleared node_modules/.cache and .next, restarted fully via the combined dev command.

DONE: /index.json shows only 7 plain 'story' entries -- no 'docs' entries anymore, confirming autodocs is fully reverted and the sidebar no longer shows a Docs tab that would just throw the upstream bug.
DONE: full app chain re-verified -- /storybook page, /storybook-app proxy, and a real POST to /api/mcp all 200.
DONE: grepped the fresh log for 'docsParameter' -- zero occurrences, confirming the background error is gone now that autodocs is off.
